messages:
Sam L.: Quick heads up — new POC with BankCorp next quarter. They require an air-gapped deployment, offline provisioning, FIPS HSM + SSO via SAML. Install window estimate: 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-15.
Mia S.: Thanks Sam. Do we have a packaging path? full bundle vs delta? customer specifically asked about patch cadence and physical media options.
Jordan (SE): We can offer minibundles + signed delta tarballs. For an islanded site I'd recommend monthly minibundles for non-critical patches, and USB hotfix deltas for emergency CVEs. See runbook link: https://redwood.infra/airgap-runbook
Sam L.: BankCorp is asking for a 90-day guaranteed upgrade window for security patches. Can we commit to that for the Private offering?
Alex P. (Security): 90-day SLA on patch availability is feasible for critical CVEs if they opt into our premium compliance add-on. Requirements: SBOM delivery, signed manifests, and documented HSM/KMS import procedure. They want hardware-backed key import.
Ida (Legal): On licensing they want an upfront per-node estimate before POC. Sales should lock a temporary pricing floor; enterprise term sheet to follow. I can draft the commercial language for the POC SOW.
Mia S.: Pricing question: can we do a 30-day POC credit + a flat handling fee for airgap media signing and shipping? Customer cares about predictable one-time costs.
Jordan (SE): Yes — standard is 30-day credits plus a media/handling fee for physical bundles. I’ll put together a checklist and cost line items (media, HSM signing ops, shipping, validation).
Sam L.: Operational: what's the recommended bootstrap for SAML SSO in offline mode? They explicitly said there will be no outbound connectivity from the cluster.
Jordan (SE): Two practical approaches:
1) Offline SAML metadata exchange + local IdP mirror (recommended for long-term air-gapped setups).
2) Temporary jumpbox with tightly-scoped egress to perform initial SAML exchange and SCIM seed, then revoke egress after onboarding.
Snippet for approach A:
```
# bootstrap (offline SAML)
1. exchange SAML metadata file between IdP and customer admin
2. upload metadata to Redwood console offline bundle
3. seed users via SCIM import file (signed)
4. rotate certs post-cutover
```
Alex P. (Security): Also: HSM import walk-through — require PKCS#12 signed key bundle, signed manifest, and operator attestation. Import should be done via an isolated workstation that writes to the HSM over direct USB or console. Record chain in SBOM and audit log.
deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded 2026-04-20T12:03:21Z: redwood-airgap-2026.04.20.tar.gz (sha256: abcd1234ef..)
Mia S.: @Jordan can you draft the minimal acceptance criteria to send BankCorp? They asked for explicit rollback steps and estimated downtime per upgrade.
Jordan (SE): Will do — acceptance criteria will include: preflight checks, checksum verification, post-install health probes, and a rollback script with expected 15–30 minute rollback window for minibundles. ETA: EOD today.
Sam L.: Also include upgrade cadence options in the doc: monthly minibundles (security-focused), quarterly full bundles (feature + security). BankCorp prefers monthly security cadence.
Ida (Legal): I'll loop in finance for the per-node quote and assemble a draft SOW with POC terms and liability language around airgap manual handling.
Mia S.: If anyone has a sample SBOM + signed-manifest template, please drop it here — customer requested an example.
Alex P. (Security): Uploaded sample manifest: https://redwood.infra/samples/airgap-manifest.json :lock:
Sam L.: :thumbsup: Let's sync tomorrow 11:00 AM PT to finalize the POC package, pricing lines, and the SOW.
